            ('x1', 'x7'): 24, ('x1', 'x8'): 24, ('x1', 'x9'): 24, ('x2', 'x3'): 24, ('x2', 'x4'): 12,
            ('x2', 'x5'): 24, ('x2', 'x6'): 24, ('x2', 'x7'): 24, ('x2', 'x8'): 24, ('x2', 'x9'): 24,
            ('x3', 'x4'): 24, ('x3', 'x5'): 24, ('x3', 'x6'): 36, ('x3', 'x7'): 24, ('x3', 'x8'): 24,
            ('x3', 'x9'): 24, ('x4', 'x5'): 24, ('x4', 'x6'): 24, ('x4', 'x7'): 24, ('x4', 'x8'): 24,
            ('x4', 'x9'): 24, ('x5', 'x6'): 24, ('x5', 'x7'): 24, ('x5', 'x8'): 24, ('x5', 'x9'): 24,
            ('x6', 'x7'): 24, ('x6', 'x8'): 24, ('x6', 'x9'): 24, ('x7', 'x8'): 24, ('x7', 'x9'): 24,
            ('x8', 'x9'): 24
        }
    )
    
    # Add constraints
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={'x1': 1, 'x2': 1, 'x3': 1, 'x4': 1, 'x5': 1, 'x6': 1, 'x7': 1, 'x8': 1, 'x9': 1}, sense='=', rhs=5)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={'x3': 1, 'x6': 1}, sense='<=', rhs=1)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={'x4': 1, 'x2': -1}, sense='<=', rhs=0)
    
    # Convert quadratic program to QUBO
    qubo_converter = QuadraticProgramToQubo()
    qubo_problem = qubo_converter.convert(qp)
    
    # Set up QAOA
    backend = Aer.get_backend('statevector_simulator')
    optimizer = QAOA(classical_optimizer=None)
    
    # Solve the QUBO problem
    qaoa = QAOA(optimizer=optimizer, reps=1, mixer=None)

    penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy = qaoa_result.fval

    return {

        'penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy': penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy,
        'runtime': runtime,
